events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with four possible scenarios for geopolitics after the war. The US military strength is being showcased, but its waning geopolitical power is also being revealed.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will lead to increased volatility in the markets. The US military strength will provide a boost to the US economy, while the waning geopolitical power will lead to a decline in emerging markets.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the war subsides or a peaceful resolution is reached

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia is expanding its AI capabilities, with partnerships with TSMC and SK hynix. This will lead to increased demand for AI chips and a boost to Nvidia's stock.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's AI spending will lead to increased demand for its chips, boosting its stock. AMD will likely suffer as a result.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Nvidia's partnerships and AI developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when Nvidia's AI spending slows down

gains.conservativeNote: If Nvidia's AI spending is moderate
